shared_elements: framed rectangular panel/scene enclosed by a border
central vertical element (tree trunk / mast) rising on the axis
a boat or hull-like form at the base of the scene
band of repeated triangular/scalloped motifs along the lower edge
arched or curved upper framing line
justification: Both surfaces enclose their imagery in a border with a central vertical axis (a tree trunk in A, a mast-like line in B), a hull-like or platform form at the base, and a row of repeated pointed motifs along the bottom — a loose but real structural echo. However, A is a densely populated figural scene of multiple elaborately costumed seated humans, foliage and ornamental scrollwork rendered in high-relief detail, whereas B is an almost empty schematic outline of a single vessel-like form over wave/scallop motifs, with no figures, so the specific content differs almost entirely.
